label: Restricted and complete-description possibility transfer
paraphrase: For every candidate-description carrier, frames E and M, description P and origin w: if every E-successor of w satisfying P is an M-successor, then E-possibility of P at w yields M-possibility of P at w. For a complete description naming one candidate v, diamond transfer from E to M is equivalent to the single inclusion of the E-edge from w to v in M. Analyst formulation, attribution deferred; no claim about which profile is metaphysically adequate.
